title: Deposit, Mobilisation, Bonding and Insurance Terms for Retrofit Project Classes
content:
# Deposit, Mobilisation, Bonding and Insurance Terms by Project Class

The commercial terms below are the terms of Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects that apply between award and the crew's first day on site. They are written per project class and do not vary within a class.

## Deposit and mobilisation

| Project class | Deposit at award (per cent of contract value) | Deposit due (calendar days from award) | Mobilisation fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Equipment Replacement Order | 50 | 7 | 0 |
| Planned Replacement Program | 35 | 10 | 1250 |
| Controls Retrofit Project | 30 | 10 | 1850 |
| Energy Retrofit Project | 25 | 14 | 3500 |
| Turnkey Mechanical Upgrade Project | 20 | 14 | 8500 |
| Design-Build Infrastructure Program | 15 | 21 | 24000 |

The deposit is taken at award as the stated portion of the contract value. The mobilisation fee is charged when the crew first mobilises to site; the Equipment Replacement Order carries none.

## Bonding, insurance and prevailing wage

| Project class | Bond required above (USD contract value) | Bond premium (per cent of contract value) | Owner-named insurance certificate before mobilisation | Written to be performed at prevailing wage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Equipment Replacement Order | 250000 | 1.5 | yes | no |
| Planned Replacement Program | 250000 | 1.5 | yes | no |
| Controls Retrofit Project | 500000 | 1.4 | yes | yes |
| Energy Retrofit Project | 500000 | 1.3 | yes | yes |
| Turnkey Mechanical Upgrade Project | 250000 | 1.25 | yes | yes |
| Design-Build Infrastructure Program | 0 | 1.1 | yes | yes |

A payment and performance bond is required where the contract value is above the class's bonding threshold, at the class's premium rate on the contract value. A threshold of 0 means every project of that class is above it, so every Design-Build Infrastructure Program project is bonded. An owner-named insurance certificate is issued before mobilisation in every class.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical values)

A Planned Replacement Program project awarded at USD 100000 carries a deposit of 35 per cent, that is USD 35000, due 10 calendar days from the award day, a mobilisation fee of USD 1250 on the crew's first day, and no bond, since 100000 is not above the class threshold of 250000. The same value written as a Design-Build Infrastructure Program would be bonded at 1.1 per cent, USD 1100.
